column1: # comment: "Awareness slice alignments \u2014 the state-of-the-experiencer axis: human awareness modes and arousal levels beside the machine operational modes (the Principle-5 bridge). EXTERNAL FRAMEWORKS NAMED IN PROSE (no stable, freely-resolvable RDF namespace is imported; GMEOW imports no external axiom, Principle 5): * NSWO (Non-REM/REM Sleep\u2013Wake Ontology) and sleep-staging vocabularies: the clinical account of wake / REM / non-REM stages is the conceptual basis of the sleep-related awareness modes (gmeow:modeAsleep / gmeow:modeREM / gmeow:modeDreaming). * SNOMED CT consciousness concepts: the clinical consciousness-state terms (alert, drowsy, obtunded, stuporous, comatose) parallel the awareness levels and the low-arousal modes; SNOMED CT is a licensed terminology, named in prose only. * Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS): the clinical arousal scale to which the lowest rungs gmeow:levelObtunded and gmeow:levelUnresponsive correspond by reference \u2014 an ordinal arousal mapping, not an imported numeric scale. * W3C PROV-O: the AI operational regimes (gmeow:modeOnlineInference / gmeow:modeTraining / gmeow:modeSampling) are also describable as prov:Activity instances; the overlap is recorded as a deliberately low-confidence relatedMatch, not a closeMatch. The machine awareness modes are SIBLINGS of the human modes bridged by ANALOGY, NOT by equivalence (Principle 5): no owl:sameAs / owl:equivalentClass couples a machine mode to a human one, and the analogue pairings (online-inference\u2248waking, offline-replay\u2248dreaming) are documented in prose, never asserted."

# # No frame-selecting mapping (Principle 9): GMEOW asserts no single 'correct' theory of consciousness or sleep staging; the value-vocab members are co-equal, and the human↔machine analogue is by reference only.

column6: gmeow:levelUnresponsive is the arousal floor; the object is a coma / Glasgow-Coma-Scale consciousness concept named by reference (SNOMED CT 'Coma'). Shared notion: unarousable unresponsiveness — loose relatedMatch only, no imported numeric scale.

gmeow:modeAsleep is a state-of-the-experiencer awareness value; SNOMED CT 'Asleep' (248218005) is a clinical finding. Shared notion: the sleep state — loose relatedMatch only; the NSWO sleep-staging account is referenced in the set comment, not imported.

gmeow:modeOnlineInference is a state-of-the-experiencer awareness value; prov:Activity is a provenance process type. Shared notion: a running operational process — loose relatedMatch only, the awareness mode is not asserted to BE a prov:Activity.
